notes.description: Three rounds a pull, tight and quick. Land the whole burst and it's over fast.
notes.range: Best within 25 m: full damage, 6 body shots. Down to 60 % (10 shots) by 70 m; reaches 160 m. Standard ballistics: by impact speed, the same distances.
notes.recoil: The legacy spread bloom (bloom per shot, cap, recovery per tick). With a family its spread comes from the family's accuracy; `maxBloom` still sets how long bots fire their bursts.
notes.group: The extended arsenal: every one fires differently. 3: rifles.
notes.model: The owner's own Desert Storm Assault Rifle (Meshy, owned, 2026-11-27; content/guns.json), sharper copies in your own hands at Medium and High; it replaced the 3DModelsCC0 M4A1. The kit burst rifle is the fallback.
